name: 5-Inch FPV Freestyle Quad

blueprint.title: 5-Inch FPV Freestyle Quad
blueprint.summary: A 230 mm carbon-fibre X quad built around a 2306 motor set, 5-inch tri-blade props, and a 30.5 mm flight-controller stack. The layout keeps the battery on the centre line above the stack, the FPV camera in a front cage, and a short whip antenna at the rear.

parts.name: Front-right arm
parts.role: Carries the front-right motor and propeller from the centre stack
parts.shape: Box arm with a circular motor boss at the outer end; build as a 112 x 26 x 3 mm box rotated 45 degrees about Y and add a 34 mm diameter boss cylinder 3 mm thick at the motor end
parts.size: 112 x 26 x 3 mm, motor boss 34 mm diameter

parts.name: Front-left arm
parts.role: Carries the front-left motor and propeller from the centre stack
parts.shape: Box arm with a circular motor boss at the outer end; build as a 112 x 26 x 3 mm box rotated -45 degrees about Y and add a 34 mm diameter boss cylinder 3 mm thick at the motor end
parts.size: 112 x 26 x 3 mm, motor boss 34 mm diameter

parts.name: Rear-right arm
parts.role: Carries the rear-right motor and propeller from the centre stack
parts.shape: Box arm with a circular motor boss at the outer end; build as a 112 x 26 x 3 mm box rotated -45 degrees about Y and add a 34 mm diameter boss cylinder 3 mm thick at the motor end
parts.size: 112 x 26 x 3 mm, motor boss 34 mm diameter

parts.name: Rear-left arm
parts.role: Carries the rear-left motor and propeller from the centre stack
parts.shape: Box arm with a circular motor boss at the outer end; build as a 112 x 26 x 3 mm box rotated 45 degrees about Y and add a 34 mm diameter boss cylinder 3 mm thick at the motor end
parts.size: 112 x 26 x 3 mm, motor boss 34 mm diameter

parts.name: Front-right motor
parts.role: Drives the front-right propeller; counter-clockwise rotation
parts.shape: Brushless motor as stacked cylinders: 24 mm diameter x 12 mm stator cylinder, 28 mm diameter x 16 mm bell above it, and a 3 mm diameter x 4 mm shaft stub on top
parts.size: 28 mm diameter, 30 mm tall overall, 3 mm shaft

parts.name: Front-left motor
parts.role: Drives the front-left propeller; clockwise rotation
parts.shape: Brushless motor as stacked cylinders: 24 mm diameter x 12 mm stator cylinder, 28 mm diameter x 16 mm bell above it, and a 3 mm diameter x 4 mm shaft stub on top
parts.size: 28 mm diameter, 30 mm tall overall, 3 mm shaft

parts.name: Rear-right motor
parts.role: Drives the rear-right propeller; clockwise rotation
parts.shape: Brushless motor as stacked cylinders: 24 mm diameter x 12 mm stator cylinder, 28 mm diameter x 16 mm bell above it, and a 3 mm diameter x 4 mm shaft stub on top
parts.size: 28 mm diameter, 30 mm tall overall, 3 mm shaft

parts.name: Rear-left motor
parts.role: Drives the rear-left propeller; counter-clockwise rotation
parts.shape: Brushless motor as stacked cylinders: 24 mm diameter x 12 mm stator cylinder, 28 mm diameter x 16 mm bell above it, and a 3 mm diameter x 4 mm shaft stub on top
parts.size: 28 mm diameter, 30 mm tall overall, 3 mm shaft

parts.name: Front-right propeller
parts.role: Produces thrust on the front-right motor; 5-inch three-blade prop
parts.shape: Propeller as a 12 mm diameter x 8 mm hub cylinder with three 63.5 mm long blade boxes, each 38 mm wide, 2 mm thick, and 18 degrees pitch, arrayed radially at 120 degrees around Y

parts.name: Front-left propeller
parts.role: Produces thrust on the front-left motor; 5-inch three-blade prop
parts.shape: Propeller as a 12 mm diameter x 8 mm hub cylinder with three 63.5 mm long blade boxes, each 38 mm wide, 2 mm thick, and 18 degrees pitch, arrayed radially at 120 degrees around Y

parts.name: Rear-right propeller
parts.role: Produces thrust on the rear-right motor; 5-inch three-blade prop
parts.shape: Propeller as a 12 mm diameter x 8 mm hub cylinder with three 63.5 mm long blade boxes, each 38 mm wide, 2 mm thick, and 18 degrees pitch, arrayed radially at 120 degrees around Y

parts.name: Rear-left propeller
parts.role: Produces thrust on the rear-left motor; 5-inch three-blade prop
parts.shape: Propeller as a 12 mm diameter x 8 mm hub cylinder with three 63.5 mm long blade boxes, each 38 mm wide, 2 mm thick, and 18 degrees pitch, arrayed radially at 120 degrees around Y

parts.name: Centre stack
parts.role: Main structural spine carrying arms, flight electronics, battery, camera, and antenna
parts.shape: Two parallel 80 x 3 x 80 mm plates 20 mm apart with four 6 mm diameter corner standoffs; top and bottom plates are boxes and standoffs are small cylinders

parts.name: Flight-controller stack
parts.role: Flight controller and 4-in-1 ESC electronics on the 30.5 mm bolt pattern
parts.shape: Two thin boards: a 36 x 1.6 x 36 mm flight-controller box on the upper plate and a 36 x 2 x 36 mm ESC box below it, connected by four 6 mm diameter standoff cylinders

parts.name: Battery
parts.role: 4S LiPo power pack strapped above the centre stack for centralised mass
parts.shape: Rounded battery brick as a 75 x 30 x 35 mm box with 6 mm corner fillets, plus a small 10 x 6 x 6 mm connector nub on the rear face

parts.name: FPV camera cage
parts.role: Front camera mount and protective cage at the nose
parts.shape: U-shaped front cage from three 2 mm thick boxes: two 18 mm long side walls and one 18 mm long top wall, with a 12 x 10 x 12 mm camera box mounted inside the opening

parts.name: Rear antenna
parts.role: FPV video receiver/antenna at the back
parts.shape: Short whip antenna as a 4 mm diameter x 45 mm cylinder with a 10 mm diameter x 4 mm base cylinder, mounted on the rear centre line

callouts: Motor-to-motor diagonal is 230 mm; adjacent motor spacing is about 163 mm, giving 28% clearance over the 127 mm prop diameter.
Propellers are shown in a neutral horizontal plane; blade pitch is 18 degrees for a 5-inch freestyle setup.
Battery is positioned on the centre line above the stack so the centre of gravity stays near the motor square centre.
Front is +Z; propellers rotate about Y. Motor spin directions alternate around the X frame.

notes: Specified by a local 27B model in 294 s (blueprint, program, critic round). Material colours corrected by hand to measured albedos (carbon fibre and black polymer reflect about 3 %).
